name: Mauao
reason: Existing: Volcanic cone with summit and base tracks, DOC/tourism board, clear headline draw.

name: Mount Maunganui Main Beach
reason: Existing: Main surf beach of the Mount, two counted sources.

name: McLaren Falls Park
reason: Existing: Lake park with waterfall, glow-worm track and camping; named by Wikivoyage and the tourism board.

name: Tauranga Historic Village
reason: Existing: Would now only reach review. For: Wikivoyage lists the Historic Village (updated Sep 2026) as a free heritage and creative precinct with shops and studios. Against: one source, mostly retail with shops open Tue-Sat 10-3, replica buildings, and bio calls it a re-created village; flag.

name: Whakaari / White Island
reason: Existing: Landings suspended since the Dec 2019 eruption; the island is seen only from flights and boat cruises outside the exclusion zone, so a visitor cannot go there. Flag: reject or hold as inaccessible (the existing bio says so).

name: Ōhope Beach
reason: Existing: Patrolled beach named by tourism board and Wikivoyage.

name: Kohi Point Scenic Reserve
reason: Existing: Would now only reach review. For: coastal walk with pā sites and viewpoints over Whakaari; a standard Whakatāne walk. Against: no counted source retrieved for Kohi Point by name in this pass (the candidate list has a different walkway, Nga Tapuwae o Toi, covering the same coast); possible near-duplicate.

name: Wai-O-Tapu
reason: Existing: Verified open 7 days 8:30-16:30 (waiotapu.co.nz); the 2021 closure note in Wikivoyage is stale. Obvious draw.

name: Te Puia
reason: Existing: Obvious draw; Pōhutu geyser and Champagne-type features are inside it.

name: Whakarewarewa Forest
reason: Existing: DOC/Wikivoyage forest with redwoods and mountain-bike trails.

name: Polynesian Spa
reason: Existing: Lakeside hot pools named by Wikivoyage.

name: Waimangu Volcanic Valley
reason: Existing: Geothermal valley with walks and a lake cruise; guide-named.

name: Hell's Gate Geothermal Park and Mud Spa
reason: Existing: Would now only reach review on counted sources: Wikipedia only found, no guidebook chapter retrieved, though it is a major paid geothermal park with a clear half-day visit and the operator's site (hellsgate.co.nz) is open. Most likely a keep once Wikivoyage/Lonely Planet is confirmed.

name: Blue Lake
reason: Existing: Blue Lake (Tikitapu) with a track and swimming beach; DOC and Wikivoyage.

name: Government Gardens
reason: Existing: Gardens open daily; the museum inside is closed for strengthening until 2027-28, so the bio, which names the Rotorua Museum, should say so.

name: Skyline Rotorua
reason: Existing: Gondola/luge to a viewpoint; Wikivoyage names it. Flag: the vehicle is the way to a summit lookout, so the bio should centre the Mount Ngongotahā viewpoint.

name: Lake Tarawera
reason: Existing: Large lake beneath Mount Tarawera with cruises and the Hot Water Beach; named by guides.

name: Lake Waikaremoana
reason: Existing: Lake Waikaremoana with a Great Walk; DOC, obvious draw.

name: Aniwaniwa Falls
reason: Existing: Waterfall cascades by a short walk from the visitor centre; DOC names Aniwaniwa Falls. Not in candidates list but a standard Waikaremoana stop.

name: Lake Waikareiti
reason: Existing: DOC lake with a walk-in hut and kayaking; named by DOC.

name: Tauranga
reason: City named by Wikivoyage (own chapter), Bay of Plenty page and the tourism board; harbour, waterfront and regional hub.

name: Mount Maunganui
reason: Town/beach resort named by the tourism board with Mauao, beach and hot pools; obvious stop (single counted source but an obvious draw).

name: Rotorua
reason: City with its own Wikivoyage chapter and a major tourist centre; obvious draw.

name: Whakatāne
reason: Town with a Wikivoyage chapter and the tourism board; base for Ōhope, Whale Island and the coast.

name: Ōpōtiki
reason: Town with Wikivoyage and tourism-board entries; gateway to the Motu Trail and Waioeka Gorge, harbour town stop.

name: Te Puke
reason: Kiwifruit-country town named by Wikivoyage and the tourism board; second-tier town stop.

name: Waihi Beach
reason: Beach town named by Wikivoyage and the tourism board with a 9 km beach and Orokawa walks.

name: Katikati
reason: For: murals town and bird gardens base. Against: no counted source named the town; the bird gardens are the draw.

name: Kawerau
reason: Mill town with no visitor-guide chapter or sight; only a permit office for Tarawera forest.

name: Ōmokoroa
reason: Commuter settlement with a cycleway; one source and nothing a visitor would travel for.

name: Te Puna
reason: Village named only as a place to eat; no distinct draw.

name: Pukehina
reason: For: tourism board names its long surf/wind-sport coast and estuary. Against: one source, small beach settlement, little to do beyond the beach.

name: Maketū
reason: Two counted sources (tourism board, Wikivoyage Te Puke); historic waka landing place with beach and cliffs, a second-tier coastal stop.

name: The Elms
reason: Te Papa Tauranga mission house with garden and guided tours open to the public; two counted sources.

name: Gate Pā
reason: For: walkable NZ Wars battlefield named by tourism board. Against: one source, mostly an interpretation site, short visit.

name: Mission Cemetery
reason: Small cemetery beside The Elms; minor site and part of that precinct.

name: Durham Redoubt
reason: Minor redoubt remnant; plaque-level, near-duplicate of The Elms precinct.

name: Monmouth Redoubt
reason: Minor redoubt remnant on the Elms grounds; minor historic marker.

name: Tauranga Art Gallery
reason: For: public gallery with changing contemporary exhibitions. Against: one source, small regional gallery, a friend would not be sent specifically.

name: Southern Waterfront Boardwalk
reason: Short urban boardwalk; one tourism-board mention and no distinct draw.

name: Marshalls Animal Park
reason: For: open animal park named by tourism board. Against: one source, small farm park, ordinary family stop. (Candidate was mis-linked to tauranga-3, which is McLaren Falls Park, so it is not in the app.)

name: Katikati Bird Gardens
reason: Gardens and wetland with native birds including kea, cafe and golf-cart tours; open to visitors for an hour or more; named by the tourism board.

name: Te Puna Quarry Park
reason: For: free volunteer-built art-and-garden park. Against: one source, local park.

name: Kaiate Falls
reason: Waterfall near Tauranga with a short walk, named by Wikivoyage among its falls.

name: Whataroa Falls
reason: For: named by Wikivoyage among Tauranga falls. Against: one source, little detail, small falls.

name: Omanawa Falls
reason: For: named by Wikivoyage. Against: one source; access has been restricted after the 2018 floods and 2023 damage, uncertain public access.

name: Wairere Falls
reason: 153 m waterfall, the North Island's tallest, with DOC track; Wikivoyage names it among the Tauranga falls. Two counted sources.

name: Pilot Bay
reason: For: calm bay and sunset spot on the Mount peninsula. Against: one source and effectively part of the Mount Maunganui beach strip.

name: Tauranga Harbour
reason: The harbour as a whole is not a placeable visit; its things (beaches, islands, boat trips) are separate entries.

name: Matakana Island
reason: For: tourism-board-named island with orchards; Wikipedia 6.9k views. Against: one source, largely private land with little visitor access, boat needed.

name: Tūhua (Mayor Island)
reason: For: two counted sources, volcanic island and marine reserve. Against: landing only by pre-arranged permission and charter, effectively inaccessible.

name: Motiti Island
reason: Inhabited island where visitors are asked not to land; seen only from cruises.

name: Papamoa Beach
reason: Long surf and swim beach named by Wikivoyage and the tourism board; a second-tier beach stop.

name: Papamoa Hills Regional Park
reason: Regional park with no visitor-guide source; local use.

name: Comvita Honey Tour
reason: Factory/operator tour; a company visitor centre rather than a place.

name: Kiwifruit Country
reason: For: kiwifruit orchard tours and tasting at Paengaroa, the region's signature crop. Against: operator-run tour, one source, a business rather than a place.

name: Golf Te Puke
reason: Golf course; an operator, not a visitor draw.

name: Orokawa Bay
reason: Pohutukawa-lined bay on a coastal walk, two counted sources; second-tier beach and walk.

name: William Wright Falls
reason: Detour waterfall on the Orokawa Bay walk; part of the larger walk spot.

name: Orokawa Scenic Reserve
reason: The reserve containing Orokawa Bay; near-duplicate of the bay entry.

name: Athenree Hot Springs
reason: For: hot-spring pools with entry fee, a place to soak for an hour. Against: one counted source, local holiday-park pools.

name: Owharoa Falls
reason: For: DOC-reached waterfall. Against: one source, short roadside-style stop; near Karangahake.

name: Karangahake Gorge
reason: Gold-mining gorge with the Windows walk and tunnels; DOC and Wikivoyage, a headline second-tier draw for the Hauraki Rail Trail area.

name: Karangahake Windows Walk
reason: The walk through Karangahake Gorge; part of the Karangahake Gorge spot.

name: Victoria Battery
reason: For: restored gold-stamping battery, DOC-named. Against: one source and adjacent to the Karangahake Gorge/Waihi area, and lies at the region edge; short visit.

name: Waihi-Waikino Goldfields Railway
reason: For: heritage railway with Waihi to Waikino run. Against: no counted source, ride is the attraction, and the stations are minor; heritage railway is acceptable only if the ride is the draw.

name: Kaimai-Mamaku Conservation Park
reason: Large conservation park whose named tracks and falls are the actual spots; too broad to be one place.

name: Aongatete Nature Trail
reason: Short DOC trail, minor and part of the Kaimai-Mamaku park.

name: Kaimai Heritage Trail
reason: Long tramline trail part of the Kaimai-Mamaku park; one source and not a distinct stop.

name: Kaimai Summit Loop Track
reason: Minor loop within Kaimai-Mamaku park; one source.

name: Te Aroha Summit Track
reason: Lies outside the Bay of Plenty region (Waikato); DOC track, assessed elsewhere.

name: Kaharoa Conservation Area
reason: Forest for kōkako with a track; the track is the visit and is a duplicate of Kaharoa Kōkako Track; local conservation area.

name: Otanewainuku Forest
reason: For: DOC native forest with giant trees and lookout track. Against: one source, rarely visited by travellers.

name: Mangorewa Ecological Area
reason: For: DOC and Wikivoyage Rotorua name the Mangorewa Track as a day tramp. Against: seasonal river conditions, demanding, few visitors.

name: Matatā Lagoon
reason: For: two counted sources, lagoon wildlife refuge and short walk. Against: modest stop, mainly a campsite and fishing spot.

name: Ōhiwa Harbour
reason: Harbour with kayak tours, birdlife and spit; Wikivoyage names it as a stop and it is a second-tier scenic harbour.

name: Whakatāne Library and Exhibition Centre
reason: Civic library building; exterior-only/civic building fails the visit test.

name: Whakatāne Gardens
reason: Ordinary town park; one source.

name: Diveworks Dolphin and Seal Encounters
reason: Operator, not a place; the places are White and Whale islands.

name: KG Kayaks
reason: Operator, not a place.

name: Moutohorā (Whale Island)
reason: Wildlife sanctuary island with fur seals and hot-water beach; two counted sources; visited by guided boat tour.

name: Ōhope Scenic Reserve
reason: Local reserve with walks; one source and part of the Ōhope area.

name: Nga Tapuwae o Toi Walkway
reason: 16 km coast-and-bush walk from Whakatāne to Ōhope with pā sites; two counted sources; a promoted day walk.

name: Tauwhare Pā Scenic Reserve
reason: Small pā reserve; short walk with minor draw.

name: White Pine Bush Track
reason: Short local bush track; one source.

name: Te Paepae o Aotea (Volkner Rocks) Marine Reserve
reason: For: DOC-named dive reserve. Against: one source, divers only by charter boat, not a land visit.

name: Ōpōtiki Museum
reason: For: local museum open weekdays and Saturday morning. Against: one source, small museum with limited hours.

name: Opotiki Rodeo
reason: Annual December event, not a permanent place.

name: Waiotahi Beach
reason: For: patrolled beach near Ōpōtiki. Against: one source, local beach.

name: Motu River Jet Boat Tours
reason: Operator, not a place.

name: Hukutaia Domain
reason: For: 4.5 ha native forest with a 2000-year-old puriri; short visit. Against: one source, a 30-minute stop for a small reserve.

name: Motu Trail
reason: Great Ride cycle trail, two counted sources; a long-trail attraction.

name: Tirohanga Dunes Trail
reason: Section of the Motu Trail; part of a larger spot.

name: Pakihi Track
reason: Section of the Motu Trail; part of a larger spot.

name: Waioeka Gorge Scenic Reserve
reason: For: scenic gorge on SH2 with short tracks. Against: one source, mostly a drive-through.

name: Kuirau Park
reason: Free central thermal park with boiling pools and footbaths, open 24 h; Wikivoyage describes it as worth a visit.

name: Blue Baths
reason: Heritage bathhouse in Government Gardens; part of that spot and the building has been closed since 2016-2022 and not a standalone visit.

name: Rotorua Museum
reason: Closed for earthquake strengthening since 2016; its site says reopening is expected 2027-28.

name: Sulphur Bay (Motutara)
reason: Boardwalk past hot springs and sulphur vents on the lakeshore, two counted sources.

name: Whakarewarewa Thermal Village
reason: Living Māori village with geothermal features and guided walks; Wikivoyage names it; distinct from Te Puia.

name: Pōhutu Geyser
reason: Feature of Te Puia (existing rotorua-2); part of a larger spot, wiki only.

name: Lady Knox Geyser
reason: Feature inside Wai-O-Tapu (existing rotorua-1), erupting daily at 10:15; part of a larger spot.

name: Champagne Pool
reason: Feature of Wai-O-Tapu (existing rotorua-1); part of a larger spot. Candidate was mis-linked to rotorua-1 but is not a separate spot.

name: Buried Village (Te Wairoa)
reason: Village buried by the 1886 eruption with museum and guided tour; Wikivoyage names it with price; clear draw.

name: Agrodome
reason: For: farm show and kiwi hatchery named by Wikivoyage, a popular family attraction. Against: single source, a commercial show with fixed times.

name: National Kiwi Hatchery
reason: For: kiwi conservation attraction. Against: one source, pairs with Rotorua other kiwi centres (e.g. Rainbow Springs) and is partly a duplicate of the Agrodome site.

name: Wingspan National Bird of Prey Centre
reason: For: bird-of-prey centre with daily flight display. Against: one source, a small centre.

name: aMaze Me
reason: For: 1.4 km hedge maze. Against: one source, a commercial novelty.

name: Mount Ngongotaha
reason: The summit reached via Skyline (existing rotorua-9); near-duplicate; the Jubilee Track is a minor walk.

name: Kerosene Creek
reason: Natural hot stream for bathing, a well-known free Rotorua stop named by Wikivoyage.

name: Waikite Valley Thermal Pools
reason: For: natural thermal pools. Against: one source, commercial pools away from the main routes.

name: Twin Streams (The Bridge)
reason: For: wild hot-and-cold stream bathing spot. Against: one source, informal roadside pull-out with a short visit and a theft risk.

name: Hamurana Springs
reason: For: spring-fed reserve on Lake Rotorua with a walk to the spring, 1.5k views. Against: only Wikipedia found, no counted visitor source; needs a second look.

name: Okere Falls
reason: Kaituna River falls with a short walk, rafting and Māori cultural site; two counted sources.

name: Rotorua Walkway
reason: 26 km council walkway; the parks it links are separate entries and a council brochure is the only guide.

name: Redwoods Forest
reason: The redwood grove in Whakarewarewa Forest; near-duplicate of existing Whakarewarewa Forest (rotorua-3), whose bio already names the redwoods.

name: Rainbow Mountain (Maunga Kākaramea)
reason: Summit walk with views and thermal craters; Wikivoyage and DOC name it; two counted sources.

name: Waiotapu Boardwalk
reason: Track in Waiotapu scenic reserve near the park of the same name; minor, one source.

name: Maunga Kākaramea Crater Lake Walk
reason: Part of the Rainbow Mountain/Maunga Kākaramea walks; near-duplicate.

name: Lake Rotorua
reason: For: the lake itself with promenade and tours. Against: a lake best seen from Sulphur Bay, Mokoia Island and the lakefront; a near-duplicate of those. One source.

name: Mokoia Island
reason: Island in Lake Rotorua with walks and Māori historic sites (Hinemoa legend), reached by boat tour; second-tier sanctuary island.

name: Tarawera Falls
reason: Waterfall via Tarawera Falls track from the lake or by permit road; DOC and Wikivoyage; a good second-tier walk.

name: Mount Tarawera
reason: For: the 1886 eruption volcano, 27k views. Against: no counted source, access is by guided tour only (private Māori-owned land).

name: Lake Ōkataina
reason: Lake with tracks and a lodge; DOC names it and it is a standard lake stop.

name: Lake Ōkareka
reason: For: DOC-named quiet lake with short tracks. Against: one source, local lake.

name: Lake Rotoiti
reason: For: DOC-named lake with forest walks and hot-pool beach. Against: one source. Candidate was mis-linked to nelson-lakes-1 (Nelson Lakes' Lake Rotoiti), a different lake; not in the app.

name: Lake Rotoma
reason: For: DOC-named lake with swimming and bridle track. Against: one source, local lake.

name: Lake Rotomahana
reason: Boat cruise and lake are part of Waimangu Volcanic Valley (existing rotorua-5).

name: Lake Rotokākahi (Green Lake)
reason: Tapu lake in private Māori ownership; no public access and no guide source.

name: Lake Rerewhakaaitu
reason: Rural recreation-reserve lake with campsites; one source and little to do.

name: Kaharoa Kōkako Track
reason: For: DOC track for the rare kōkako. Against: one source, remote and a niche birding trail.

name: Lake Waikaremoana Great Walk
reason: For: one of the nine Great Walks (DOC). Against: near-duplicate of existing Lake Waikaremoana (te-urewera-1), whose bio is largely the walk; decide whether to keep both.

name: Panekire Bluffs
reason: Lookout section of the Waikaremoana Great Walk; part of a larger spot.

name: Lake Kaitawa Fairy Springs Track
reason: For: short DOC walk to Fairy Springs. Against: one source, minor.

name: Ruapani Circuit Track
reason: Circuit around a small lake in Te Urewera; one source, remote tramping loop; minor.

name: Te Urewera National Park
reason: A destination in the app already; not a spot of itself (near-duplicate).

name: Te Urewera Visitor Centre at Te Kura Whenua
reason: Information building, not a distinct attraction.

name: Whirinaki Te Pua-a-Tāne Conservation Park
reason: DOC conservation park of ancient podocarp forest with tracks; a recognised destination for walkers.

name: Whirinaki Track
reason: A track in Whirinaki Conservation Park; part of a larger spot.

name: Waiatiu Falls Track
reason: For: DOC waterfall walk in Whirinaki. Against: one source and inside the park already assessed.

name: Te Pua-a-Tāne Circuit
reason: Circuit in Whirinaki Conservation Park; part of a larger spot.
